t: A machine used to cook rice perfectly to $(6)Uncle Roger$() standards. To cook it you will need Rice, Water and some fuel to cook it up. $(br2)You won't have to worry about the weights in the output slot, Cooked Rice will be combined automatically.
一台专为将稻米烹煮至$(6)罗杰叔叔$()标准而设计的机器。烹煮时需准备稻米、水以及一定量的燃油。$(br2)输出槽中的重量无需担心，米饭将自动合并为 cooked rice（米饭）。
